After sprinting for 3 seconds:
Increases Reload Speed for 3 seconds.

Duration can be refreshed by tapping sprint. Being <arc/>Amplified increases the bonus.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased. Stronger effect when <arc/>Amplified.

After sprinting for 3 seconds:
Grants 20 Reload Speed for 3 seconds. Duration can be refreshed by sprinting.

Being <arc/>Amplified increases the bonus to 60 Reload Speed.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased. Even stronger effect while <arc/>Amplified.
)

Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

Duration can be refreshed by sprinting again.

Being <arc/>Amplified removes the requirement to sprint and increases the Reload Speed benefit to 60.

enhanced (
#e Buff duration is increased. Even stronger effect while <arc/>Amplified.
)

Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.

Being <arc/>Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.
